body: PR 1 of 2 opened: #45, the search-outage defect (audit row B-122): a search that could not be made was answered as a permanent 404 song_unavailable/removed (the app never retried it, the keeper gave the song up, an import called it missing). Now search_failed: 502 source_unreachable, retryable, waited out by the keeper and the imports. Four failing tests first, the whole server suite and the gate green. Built, not walked. The N-13 code PR follows once #45 is merged.
